evidence.claim: Ke merges existing roots, task/git-origin inferred roots and manually added roots using imported R-derived deduplication keys; lt ignores remote task records. Labels use trimmed saved label or imported fallback dt. These are candidate computations, not a live project list or proof of the imported normalizer semantics.
evidence.method: frozen-source AST and lexical export/import review; no target evaluation

evidence.claim: Add project is a local menu with Start from scratch and Use an existing folder. Remote host uses the folder callback directly. Start from scratch runs on menu close autofocus only when selected. Folder callback dispatches electron-pick-workspace-root-option with allowMultiple:false.
evidence.method: frozen-source AST and lexical export/import review; no target evaluation

evidence.claim: The exact main case awaits projectFolderPicker.pickProjectSources. Non-local hosts emit remote-workspace-root-requested. Local picker permits openDirectory/createDirectory, optional multiselect/hidden files; cancel returns no roots. Selected paths are normalized/stat-checked directories; stat failures are logged and filtered. Each retained root emits workspace-root-option-picked.
evidence.method: frozen-source AST and lexical export/import review; no target evaluation

evidence.claim: workspace-root-option-picked adds and checks the root locally. Single toggle adds the root to manual candidates and writes M[root]; select-all writes each candidate V entry. This does not call project registration. Local rows use paths-exist and hide missing paths; remote rows skip that check. V is computed before row filtering, so do not equate V with mounted rows.
evidence.method: frozen-source AST and lexical export/import review; no target evaluation

evidence.claim: Continue UI is disabled for no selected roots, loading, or any pendingAction. Callback clears error and uses the pendingAction guard. Shared async q uses a separate Re.current latch, merges existing roots only when override is workspace, and calls Me().createOrSelectLocalProjects. Imported Mln resolves exactly to mI, which throws when Pd.projects is absent.
evidence.method: frozen-source AST and lexical export/import review; no target evaluation

evidence.claim: Only the returned project-operation Promise installs finally resetting Re.current. Empty returned array stops completion; rejected Promise resets the latch then reaches manual inline error or automatic toast. A synchronous factory/method failure before Promise.finally can leave Re.current true; the caller still clears pendingAction. No cancellation or latch timeout is declared here.
evidence.method: frozen-source AST and lexical export/import review; no target evaluation

evidence.claim: Nonempty registration records onboarding time, resets override to auto, increments focus nonce, and navigates replace only if captured/current location key matches or the precise root-location fallback passes. Automatic continuation fires at most once when no existing/inferred roots, not loading, and selected roots exist; its Fe latch is set before the call and not reset on failure.
evidence.method: frozen-source AST and lexical export/import review; no target evaluation

evidence.claim: Skip and local Start from scratch share the skip callback. It guards pendingAction, sends initializeGitRepository:!scope.get(ue). Result event always clears pending; success records completion/reset, failure sets supplied error or null. Skip UI is absent remotely and disabled while pending; it has no timeout or abort control.
evidence.method: frozen-source AST and lexical export/import review; no target evaluation

evidence.claim: Main skip awaits default-root creation and project registration. An empty project result sends success:false without an error string. Nonempty sends success:true/root then navigate-to-route / with onboardingCompletion and focus nonce. Caught errors send success:false, available root and error text. Sending these messages does not prove renderer receipt.
evidence.method: frozen-source AST and lexical export/import review; no target evaluation

evidence.claim: Default base name is New project. createDefaultWorkspaceRoot rejects when imported r.Bi(this.host) is true with a local-host-only error; the predicate actual value is not evaluated. It sanitizes the name, searches Documents/ChatGPT with suffix 2,3,... when occupied, then calls mkdir. If requested, initializeDefaultWorkspace checks Git availability and requests git-init-repo. Unavailable Git or caught initialization error does not fail the outer skip; created directory cleanup/rollback is not declared.
evidence.method: frozen-source AST and lexical export/import review; no target evaluation
